summary_paragraph: Mr. ___ was admitted with cellulitis and new pressure ulcers on both feet, discovered after he noticed redness and raw skin while being unable to feel pain due to paraplegia. He had a prior allergic reaction to vancomycin in the ED, prompting a switch to linezolid, which led to clinical improvement. Wound care was initiated, and a scheduled nephrostomy tube exchange was performed without complications. His infection resolved, white blood cell count normalized, and back pain stabilized. He was discharged home with instructions to complete a 10-day course of linezolid, continue protective foot care with waffle boots, and follow up with urology, nephrology, and plastic surgery.
problems: Cellulitis and abscess of foot, except toes
